message:
Partial refunds are fixed. `npm test` now passes all 20 tests, including `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`.

The bug was in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`. `percent` is documented as 0-100, but the code multiplied the amount by it directly, so a 50% refund of 1250 came out as 62500. I changed the calculation to divide by 100:

```js
amount: Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100)
```

`partialRefund` has no other callers in the repo, so nothing else needed to change. I didn't commit the change.
